jobs.occupation: Technician, Buffer Solution Preparation (Late Day Shift)
jobs.description:
Location: Søborg, Copenhagen, Denmark. AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

Working hours: 08:00–19:04

**About The Job

**Are you quality-minded, reliable, and motivated by working in a structured production environment where accuracy and compliance are essential? Do you take pride in your work and understand the importance of following procedures, even when working under time pressure? Then you may be our new Technician in Buffer Solution Preparation at AGC Biologics.

You will join our Solution Preparation team in SYD22, a new, state-of-the-art facility currently in the ramp-up phase. Production supports preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing for a wide range of international clients.

The team consists of three skilled technicians who work closely together and collaborate with key stakeholders, including QA and Manufacturing Product Support. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable, high-quality buffer preparation while ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements and minimizing the risk of deviations.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning and preparing the buffers used in protein purification processes. The position requires a strong quality mindset, attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and the ability to maintain an overview of your tasks while ensuring that established procedures and quality standards are never compromised.

**Your Work Will Include

**

• Planning and executing daily buffer preparation activities according to approved production records, recipes, and procedures.

• Ensuring buffers are prepared and delivered on time to support production schedules.

• Completing batch documentation accurately and promptly, ensuring that all activities are documented in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Following cGMP requirements, Manufacturing Production Records (MPRs), and approved procedures at all times.

• Working in compliance with regulatory and quality systems, including TrackWise, where relevant.

• Supporting daily production planning and coordinating activities to ensure timely delivery.

• Assisting with troubleshooting, production-related challenges, and ad hoc tasks.

• Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and contributing to their implementation.

• Working independently and reliably while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues and relevant stakeholders.

• Maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, including when working under time pressure.

**About You

**We imagine that you:

• Preferably hold an education as a Process Operator, Process Technologist, Industrial Operator, or a similar relevant qualification.

• Have preferably at least two years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry and experience working in a cGMP-regulated environment.

• Have experience preparing buffers according to recipes and instructions defined in production records.

• Have a good understanding of GMP documentation and the importance of accurate, timely documentation.

• Have an understanding of LEAN, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Can speak, read, and understand English fluently.

• Work systematically and consistently, including when performing repetitive tasks.

• Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.

As a person, you take pride in your work and understand that quality and compliance are essential in pharmaceutical manufacturing. You remain calm and maintain an overview when priorities change or time pressure increases. You know when to act with urgency and when to stop and seek clarification rather than compromise established standards or procedures.

You are positive, flexible, and willing to take on new assignments and responsibilities. You work independently when needed but also value teamwork and contribute to a professional and supportive working environment.

**Working Hours

**The position follows a defined shift schedule, with working hours from 08:00 to 19:04. Production operates 24/7, including weekends and public holidays, and flexibility to work during these periods is required according to the assigned shift plan.

**What We Offer

**

• A hands-on operational role in a modern production facility supporting preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing.

• An international working environment at AGC Biologics, with close collaboration across functions such as QA and Manufacturing Product Support.

• A strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, supported by structured processes and clear expectations in a cGMP environment.

• On-the-job training and opportunities to develop your technical skills within buffer preparation.

• A professional and collaborative team culture with experienced colleagues and a strong emphasis on teamwork, accountability, and reliability.

• A structured shift-based work model supporting round-the-clock production operations.

• Competitive employment terms, including salary, pension, health insurance, and employee benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to a paid canteen arrangement with meals prepared by professional chefs.

• An active Employee Club offering social events and activities throughout the year.

• Opportunities to receive discounts on a variety of leisure activities and experiences throughout the year.

**Application and Contact

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible.

Please submit your application no later than 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

_**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist, Experimental Quantum Photonics
jobs.description:
Sparrow Quantum is seeking an experimental physicist to develop deterministic entanglement sources for photonic quantum computing. You will build and automate experiments on single quantum emitters coupled to photonic nanostructures, taking responsibility for the optical setup, the supporting electronics and the control software, and translate the results into technical direction for device and system development.

Your role

• 
Design, build and operate quantum optics experiments combining integrated photonics, cryogenics and single-photon detection

• 
Take ownership of the software for instrument control, experiment automation and data acquisition, and keep it maintainable, versioned and usable by the rest of the team

• 
Design and build simple electronics and hardware for the lab, such as driver circuits, interface boards, interlocks and mechanical fixtures

• 
Contribute to research activities on photonic quantum computing and share results clearly with the team

• 
Collaborate with academic and industrial partners in national and European projects

Must have

• 
PhD in physics or a closely related field

• 
Hands-on experience in an optics lab, in academia or industry

• 
Strong practical skills in free-space and fibre optics, lasers and spectroscopy

• 
Solid programming skills, ideally in Python, for controlling hardware and automating experiments, and a genuine drive to write good code rather than just enough to get by

• 
Curiosity and the persistence to track down problems and refine the final result

• 
Willingness to collaborate and deliver results in a clear and structured way

• 
Strong focus on the final goal, self-discipline and prioritisation

Nice to have

• 
Experience with Git and GitHub, including code review and collaborative development

• 
Experience with single quantum emitters, such as quantum dots, colour centres, atoms, ions or molecules

• 
Experience with cryostats, single-photon detectors and time-tagging electronics

• 
Familiarity with FPGA or real-time control, electro-optic modulators and fast electronics

• 
Experience with InAs/GaAs quantum dots and integrated quantum photonics, including waveguides, photonic crystals or cavities

• 
Knowledge of quantum information, including multiphoton entanglement, cluster states or photonic quantum computing

• 
A track record of scientific publications

What you can expect

• 
A central role in building the experimental and software infrastructure of a company at the forefront of photonic quantum computing

• 
A high-performance team of highly motivated people working towards photonic quantum computing

• 
Contributing to scientific publications and patents

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Lunches paid by the company

• 
The possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing

• 
A steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the boundary between research and industry

How to apply

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

How to apply: Scroll down to apply with your CV and a short cover letter (in English).

Application deadline: November 23.

Starting date: As soon as possible.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis

Short-listed candidates will be invited for an in-person interview in Copenhagen. Travel and accommodation will be covered.

For questions, contact Alexey Tiranov.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company dedicated to advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies. We are recognized globally for our high-performance single-photon sources and our foundational contributions to the quantum internet and quantum computing.

jobs.occupation: Håndmand/kvinde søges til arbejde på jernbanen.
jobs.description:
MEDARBEJDERE SØGES TIL ARBEJDE PÅ JERNBANEN

Vi vækster så vi ikke kan følge med, så har du lyst til at arbejde udendørs og blive en del af et stærkt team? 

Vi søger nemlig medarbejdere til buskrydning dag/nat, samt kabelvagter nat, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Om jobbet

Arbejdet som buskrydder består af, beskæring af grønne arealer langs jernbanen. Erfaring med buskbeskæring er ikke et krav, men vi forventer, at du kan håndtere værktøj på en forsvarlig og sikker måde.

Arbejdet som kabelvagt består af, markering af drift kabler langs jernbanen. Dette er som udgangspunkt natarbejde. Erfaring er ikke et krav, men der bliver gået mange km på flere slags underlag, herunder skaver mm.  

- Vi har base i Korsør, men arbejdet foregår på hele Sjælland

- Som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen.

- Weekend- og overarbejde kan forekomme

Vi forventer, at du:

- Er mødestabil

- Er ansvarsbevidst

- Har gå på mod

- Har lyst til at lære nyt

Krav:

- Kørekort til bil. 

- Over 18 år

Derudover:

“Pas på banen”-kursus er et krav, så det er en kæmpe fordel hvis du allerede har det. Men hvis du ikke har det, sørger vi for at du får det. 

Vi tilbyder:

- Hurtig opstart

- Gode kollegaer og den rette oplæring

- Løn efter kvalifikationer

Send din ansøgning til Kundeservice@estotalbyg.dk og skriv gerne hvilken stilling du søger.

jobs.occupation: Work in the evenings and earn extra – Join Imerco’s Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary evening job in November and December? Do you enjoy being physically active, working at a fast pace, and being part of a great team? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for the evening shift at Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4-5 evening shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6. The training will take place in the beginning of November.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

Detta söker vi:

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Enjoys routine-based and independent work

• 
Has a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

• 
Is reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for their shifts

• 
Is physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the shift

• 
Has good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

• 
Is available for 4 evening shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

• 
Is available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking, dependable, and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We offer an exciting temporary evening position in a well-established retail company, where you will become part of a friendly and supportive team. You will gain valuable warehouse experience, work in a structured environment with clearly defined tasks, and have the opportunity to earn extra money during the busy Christmas season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour, in addition to which evening and weekend supplements are provided.

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate, Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply, Portfolio & Project Delivery team in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers opportunities to develop beyond inspection readiness. Working closely with Clinical Supply Managers in the Portfolio & Project Delivery team and colleagues across the department, you will support selected operational tasks and initiatives while gaining broader exposure to clinical trial management. Through collaboration with Clinical Trial Operations and CROs, and hands-on involvement in clinical supply activities, you will further develop your GCP and clinical supply knowledge.

The position is based in Copenhagen.

**Responsibilities

**

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support activities related to day-to-day trial management, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Support distribution and logistics, including tasks related to shipment documentation, in alignment with the Drug Supply Managers.

• Build knowledge of especially GCP but also GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply, Portfolio & Project Delivery function

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GCP and GMP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GCP/GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functional with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

**The Team

**You will be part of a highly competent team focused on end-to-end trial management including planning and maintenance of supplies for clinical trials, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders in both CMC and Clinical Trial Operations.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Finance Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: On location in Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

The Role

The Finance Systems Engineer will own the systems, data infrastructure, and internal tooling that power Teton’s finance function.

As Teton continues to scale, we need reliable financial data, connected systems, and automated workflows that allow the business to operate efficiently and make informed decisions. You will help strengthen our operational finance capabilities by ensuring our data is accurate, our systems work as intended, and our internal processes are scalable.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of finance, systems engineering, and data. You will build integrations between our accounting platform, ERP, CRM, and internal product systems, develop tools that make business intelligence data easier to access, and establish controls that maintain data integrity.

What You’ll Own

Finance Data and Systems Infrastructure

• 
Own the systems and data flows supporting Teton’s finance function, ensuring financial information is accurate, accessible, and reliable.

• 
Maintain and improve integrations between accounting, ERP, CRM, and internal product systems.

• 
Identify infrastructure gaps and implement scalable solutions that support Teton’s growth.

Systems Integrations and Automation

•

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer(Product)
jobs.description:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

The position requires a physical presence at our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data.

In this role, you will focus on:

• 
Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

• 
Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

• 
Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them.

• 
Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

• 
Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

• 
Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

• 
Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

• 
Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI.

• 
Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

• 
Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

• 
Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

• 
AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

• 
Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

• 
Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

• 
Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages.

What We Offer

• 
Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

• 
A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

• 
A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.

• 
Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

jobs.occupation: Data & Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****What the role is

****We're looking for a Data & Automation Specialist who loves digging into data, and wants to use that foundation to make every team at Onomondo work smarter.

Your starting point is data. You'll work with complex, messy, multi-source data, from billing and revenue to product usage and commercial pipelines and turn it into analysis, dashboards and answers the business can act on. You'll partner with teams across the company (Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations) to understand what they need to know, and build the reporting that gets them there.

From that foundation, you'll look for where the data shows us time being lost, and fix it. That might be a script, an integration, a scheduled job, or an AI skill where that is the right approach. Getting there often means untangling messy data or a half-broken process first and you don't shy away from that groundwork when it's what the job actually needs.

AI is a real and growing part of the toolkit here. As you settle in, there's plenty of room to grow into that area. This includes our AI infrastructure and production agent stack, ready to be taken to the next level. Our vision is a backbone data warehouse with all data sources available so that our colleagues can self-service with trust through AI.

You'll report to our Data Analytics Manager, Jonathan, and be part of the Insights team.

****What you'll do

• Working with complex data across billing, revenue, product usage and commercial systems. Cleaning, modelling and making sense of it

• Building dashboards and visualizations that teams actually use to make decisions. We currently use Tableau for most of our complex visualizations, but we foresee leaning into an in-house setup. Groundwork is already in place to allow for broader adoptions and flexibility

• Running deeper analyses on the questions that matter, from revenue and billing trends to customer behavior and operational efficiency

• Finding the manual, repetitive workflows that cost the company the most time, and automating them in whatever form actually fits

• Building and maintaining integrations between the tools teams already use (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and others)

• Authoring and iterating AI skills where they're the right tool, using Onomondo's existing skill framework

• Growing into deeper AI/agent infrastructure work over time. Connectors, permissioning, production agents and moreNot all at once, of course. We'll start with what matters most, build it to scale, then keep going.

****What we're looking for

• Strong with data: comfortable with SQL, working in a data warehouse (we use BigQuery), and handling complex, imperfect datasets

• Experienced in data visualization and analysis. You can turn a messy question into a clear chart and a clear answer

• Comfortable writing code (Python or similar) to analyse, transform and automate

• A fixer by instinct. You notice friction and want to remove it, without needing to be asked

• Curious about AI, LLMs and agents, and keen to explore how they can make data and processes work better - even if that's not your primary experience yet

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity: nobody will hand you a fully-scoped ticket, you'll often have to find the problem first

• Communicates clearly and works well directly with non-technical stakeholders across teams

Nice to have, though not required: experience with Tableau or similar BI tools, billing or financial data, data modelling, workflow orchestration tools, exposure to LLMs/agents or MCP, or a general understanding of how SaaS businesses run (subscriptions, revenue metrics, GTM tooling, and the cross-team workflows common at software companies).

****Applying

****Your application doesn't need to be polished and you don't need to check all the boxes, to apply.

Tell us what you built, what you were trying to move, and what happened.

****Life at Onomondo

****The things we build have global reach. The way we build them is personal. We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: paid health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with workouts (HIIT of yoga) three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

**That means:

**

• We don’t need your picture

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

**What you can expect:

**

• Screening call with Madalina, our Head of People (Online, 30 minutes)

• Skill interview with Jonathan & Mateusz, our Data Analytics Manager & Head of Revenue Operations (In-Person, 1 hour)

• Meet with our Co-Founder, Michael (In-Person, 30 minutes)

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in Computational Lexicography and Linguistics at the Centre for Language Technology, Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics, UCPH
jobs.description:
The Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics, Faculty of Humanities, University of Copenhagen (UCPH), Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral fellowship in Computational Lexicography and Linguistics to be filled by the 1st of March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics is home to 1600 students and 160 members of staff. It provides the setting for international research and education from BA to PhD studies within language, language technology, Natural Language Processing, literature, media, culture, and gender studies.

  The successful candidate will be attached to both the Centre for Language Technology (CST), which is one of the research centres of the department, and to the Society of Danish language and Literature (DSL) which compiles and publishes dictionaries and language technology resources for Danish at a scholarly basis, often in research projects in collaboration with CST. The latter affiliation will amount to around six months of the total hiring period of 24 months.

  CST conducts research in different areas of interest for language technology, such as Natural Language Processing, construction of NLP resources, Computational Cognitive Modeling and Multimodality, NLP infrastructure and policy, Representation Learning for NLP and Digital Humanities, among others.  It has a strong international profile, at the same time as pursuing the development of language technology methods and resources for the Danish language. The Centre has considerable experience managing international research projects, frequently attracts visiting researchers, and has organised major conferences in the field. In collaboration with the Department of Computer Science at the University of Copenhagen, it offers an international MSc programme in IT and Cognition. The programme, which currently admits about 30 students a year, comprises a range of courses in Natural Language Processing and Cognitive Science. In addition, we teach at several BA programs and electives, such as the BA ‘Kognitions- and Datavidenskab’ hosted at the Department of Psychology and an elective package on Language-Centric AI for students in the Humanities.

  Job content
 The successful candidate will contribute to the project ELEXAI, which focuses on a European Lexicographic Infrastructure for Artificial Intelligence (https://www.eurac.edu/en/projects/elexai), granted by the European Commission under the Horizon Europe Program.

  The candidate will in particular contribute to the project’s work packages on LLM Benchmarking, the so-called LexBench, which is led by CST and also involves DSL. This part of the project investigates how benchmarks for Natural Language Understanding can be compiled mono- and multilingually from lexical resources and datasets. The position involves designing and compiling such benchmarks in close collaboration with DSL and the other European partners of the project and to apply them in diverse evaluation scenarios. A particular focus will be put on benchmarking word understanding capabilities and on the understanding of figurative language, including the cultural bias that this part of the language may evoke in LLMs.

  Ideal candidates for this work have a background in computational lexicography and/or computational linguistics, with experience in lexicographical work and with good programming skills. It is an advantage although not a requirement, if the candidate has good knowledge of the Danish language.

  Teaching qualifications are not a requirement, since the candidate will not be involved in teaching.
